Fixes for the first reports from a real console, plus the lake boat. Each console fix below has a cause found in the code, but none of them can be confirmed in Azahar, so they stay unconfirmed until they are tried on hardware again.

**Fixed for consoles**

- **Characters too dark.** The 3DS GPU keeps 8 bits per light colour, and the game's character lights (up to about 1.4, times the brightness setting) went past that and wrapped round to almost black. Azahar reads more bits, so it showed them as meant. Character lights now go to the GPU at half strength and the texture combiner doubles them back, which gives the same picture in Azahar and keeps every value in range on a console.
- **Stuttering video and voices in cutscenes.** Two causes. The audio thread only refilled its buffers when the main loop asked, once a frame, so a frame spent loading a scene or an area (seconds on a console's SD card) left the sound with nothing to play; it now also wakes on its own every 20 ms. And the console reads the SD card one request at a time, so a big read held up the music's and the voice's small reads; the audio now keeps several seconds read ahead, and large files are read in 64 KB pieces so the audio gets its turn. On a simulated console-speed card, the warp into Angela's scene went from one audio gap to none. The debug screen and `perflog` now count audio gaps.
- **Rotational controls and the D-pad turned the wrong way.** Turning, strafing, the quick turn, aiming without a target, looking around and the boat all had left and right swapped. Positional sound was swapped as well.
- **The flashlight button did nothing.** That part is as on the PC until James finds the flashlight in Wood Side Apartments. But the button used to click and switch an invisible light before then; it now does nothing until he has it, and the light only shines once he does.

**Also new**

- The lake boat, rowed with the PC's own controls, from the town pier to the hotel.
- The endings, the clear data and New Game+ checked against the PC, with several score counters fixed.
- The rest of the Enhanced Edition's options that apply to the port, a fix for a dark wedge drawn over the street near the town's centre, and the fog's area data read once at start-up instead of on the first frame of each area.

**Updating from 0.1.1**

Install the new `sh23ds.cia` over the old one; saves carry over. The boat needs two new data files, `chr/boat/boat.s3a` and `chr/jms/jms_boat.s3a`, which the packer now makes.
